study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Ge et al., Lancet Digital Health, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative modelling of brain morphometry across the lifespan with CentileBrain: algorithm benchmarking and model optimisation

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Eight algorithms were compared for normative modeling. MFPR (Multivariate Fractional Polynomial Regression) emerged as the preferred algorithm due to its combined advantages in accuracy and computational efficiency. Other algorithms tested include: OLSR, BLR, GAMLSS (including LMS subclass), GPR, WBLR, and HBR. The optimal models were sex-specific and region-specific models based on MFPR with non-linear fractional polynomials of age and linear effects of global neuroimaging measures.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional morphometric measures from T1-weighted MRI: 68 cortical thickness (CT) measures from Desikan-Killiany atlas regions, 68 cortical surface area (SA) measures from the same regions, 14 subcortical volumetric measures (SubV) based on Aseg atlas. Global measures include total intracranial volume (TIV), mean cortical thickness, and total surface area. A total of 150 regional morphometry measures were modeled.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Morphometric feature extraction from whole-brain T1-weighted images was implemented with the standard pipelines in the FreeSurfer image analysis suite (appendix 2) to yield global measures of total intracranial volume, mean cortical thickness, and total surface area, as well as measures of cortical thickness and cortical surface area from the 68 Desikan-Killiany atlas regions and 14 subcortical volumetric measures based on the Aseg atlas.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The optimal models included non-linear fractional polynomials of age and linear effects of global neuroimaging measures. Specifically: intracranial volume (ICV) for models of regional subcortical volumes, mean cortical thickness for models of regional cortical thickness, and total cortical surface area for models of regional cortical surface area. Sex was handled by building separate sex-specific models rather than as a covariate. Scanner vendor, FreeSurfer version, and Euler number were tested but had minimal effect on model performance and were not included in the final optimized models.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Accordingly, we define the optimal models as the sex-specific and region-specific models that were based on the MFPR algorithm with non-linear fractional polynomials of age and linear eﬀects of the appropriate global neuroimaging measure (ie, intracranial volume for models of regional subcortical volumes, mean cortical thickness for models of regional cortical thickness, and total cortical surface area for models of regional cortical surface area).
